card.name: The word be after can or should
card.fires_on: The word "be" right after "can" or "should" in warning sentences, especially "which can be fatal" in NSAID boxed warnings.

modes.label: Can be fatal
modes.description: "be" after "which can" at the end of a list of serious events, just before "fatal".
modes.example: and perforation of the stomach or intestines, which can<< be>> fatal. These events can occur at any

modes.label: Should be evaluated
modes.description: "be" after "should" in advice that serious conditions need a provider's review.
modes.example: Some of these conditions are potentially serious, and should<< be>> evaluated by a qualified healthcare provider. M
